source_note: Both native binaries include the same preexisting local SVG changes. Those unrelated changes are not included in this commit. The baseline binary is the published round-five final binary.

fixed_work_comparison.method: Same release renderer test binary, 120 tracks and 60 completed mutation states per mode. Separate processes toggle only the paint exclusion cache; local paint reuse is enabled and scroll compositor takeover disabled. One state in flight; document and scroll tile completion checked. Applied state and installed-tree pixel checks run outside measured intervals. Process CPU includes worker threads. Elapsed time includes completion barriers. Work equality requires identical completed state, layout, document job, document install, scroll raster and tile job counts across all rounds of each mode. Renderer callbacks are not treated as completed frames. This is a renderer-component comparison, not WebKit, full-host throughput or display FPS.
fixed_work_comparison.order: Cache off then on in round 1; reversed in alternate rounds

comparison.method: Serial baseline and optimized native binaries plus WebKit; reverse order in round two. Both native binaries enable the published scroll batching and obsolete-raster cancellation. Selected additionally caches canonical resolved paint exclusions with unchanged raster work. Experimental scroll-owned takeover is disabled. Transport recording disabled. CPU is percent of one core, including WebKit helpers, excluding WindowServer. Host callbacks are not display FPS.
comparison.work_count_note: Native-only tile work is measured over the CPU measurement interval, normalized by sandbox callbacks; these are not display frames. Layout counts include the entire capture, including startup and warmup. Different free-running work counts prevent treating CPU percentage as cost per equal completed state.

rejected_all_scopes_probe.reason: Scoped admission retained many one-off entries (59 in fixed work) and gave smaller contained-work savings (6.7%) than full-root-only admission (13.8%). The final integration admits only full-document roots. Live clipped CPU rose, but live work counts also differ, so that is not proof of per-work regression.

manual.scope: Manual functional checks and sampled visual states; not a frame-by-frame hitch-free guarantee.

remaining_limits: The change removes redundant exclusion resolution only; it does not reduce the number of completed tile rasters or layouts.
Free-running callback counts are not display FPS and do not hold completed paint work constant.
Only macOS integration was measured. The cache container is portable C++ and has standalone tests; other platform performance was not measured.
Offscreen paint deferral remains unimplemented. Strict fresh first exposure requires a host scroll/display handoff; asynchronous viewport publication alone is insufficient.
No universal speedup, 2x advantage over WebKit, or hitch-free 60 FPS result is established.
